title: Operating Limits of Ridge-Based Sparse IMU Gait Estimation Under Sensor-Frame Rotation
description: v1.0.1 reproducibility archive for IEEE Sensors Journal manuscript Sensors-113886-2026. Includes the exact hash-verified derived virtual-IMU NPZ, portable model code, all 5 participant-disjoint fold reruns, participant-level RMSE outputs, and reviewer-requested virtual sensitivity analyses. Raw C3D-to-NPZ reconstruction and physical HDF5 re-execution are not claimed.

creators.name: Sergio de N. R. L. Jr.
